name: DevSynt Hiring - 1. Application Intake, Screening & Acknowledgment

parameters.content:
## Workflow 1 — Intake, Screening & Acknowledgment

**Flow:**
1. Fetch new applications from IMAP (email) and Google Sheets (form)
2. Normalize both into one common shape
3. Insert into Supabase `candidates` table
4. Send acknowledgment email to candidate
5. Call an AI model to score the resume vs job requirements
6. Parse score -> classify Strong/Average/Weak (bands: 75-100 / 50-74 / <50)
7. Update the Supabase record with ats_score + classification

**Before running:**
- Attach your IMAP, Google Sheets, Supabase, SMTP/Email, and OpenAI credentials on the respective nodes (currently blank placeholders).
- In Supabase, add a UNIQUE constraint on (email, role_applied) and consider using 'upsert' on the Insert node to avoid duplicate applications automatically.
- Set JOB_REQUIREMENTS text inside the 'AI Resume Scoring' node body to match the role you're screening for.

parameters.subject: Thanks for applying to DevSynt!
parameters.html:
Hi {{$json.name}},

Thanks for applying to DevSynt for the {{$json.role_applied}} role. We've received your application and our team will review it shortly.

We'll be in touch soon with next steps.

— The DevSynt Hiring Team

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "gpt-4o-mini", response_format: { type: "json_object" }, messages: [ { role: "system", content: "You are an ATS resume screener. Score the candidate's resume against the job requirements on a 0-100 scale. Respond ONLY with strict JSON: {\"ats_score\": number, \"reasoning\": string}. JOB REQUIREMENTS: " + $json.role_applied + " - Adjust this text to your actual job requirements." }, { role: "user", content: "Candidate resume:\n" + $json.resume_text } ] }) }}

nodes.notes: Header auth credential should set 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_OPENAI_KEY'. continueOnFail is on so a failed AI call doesn't stop the pipeline (handled in next node).
